map.根据医嘱总量和时间计算输液滴速。: Convert a prescribed infusion volume and duration into drops per minute and millilitres per hour for a given drop factor, with a rounded practical setting suggested.

map.📚 深度解析：输液滴速计算: 📚 Deep Dive: IV Drip Rate Calculation
map.临床调速：由总量与时间算滴速与秒/滴: Clinical rate setting: compute the drip rate and seconds per drop from volume and time
map.护理执行：按滴系数设输液器与调速夹: Nursing execution: set the giving set and roller clamp by the drop factor
map.安全核查：滴速过快/过慢都影响疗效与安全: Safety check: too fast or too slow both affect efficacy and safety
map.算法：总滴数 = 液体量(mL) × 滴系数(gtt/mL)；滴速 = 总滴数: Algorithm: total drops = volume (mL) × drop factor (gtt/mL); drip rate = total drops ÷ time (min); seconds per drop = 60 ÷ drip rate. All values must be >0. Common drop factors are 15/20 gtt/mL.
map.例1（500mL / 120min / 滴系数 20）：总滴数 500×20 =: Example 1 (500 mL / 120 min / drop factor 20): total drops 500×20 = 10000, drip rate 10000/120 = 83.3 drops/min, about 0.72 s/drop. Example 2 (1000 mL / 240 min / drop factor 15): total drops 15000, drip rate 62.5 drops/min, about 0.96 s/drop.
map.滴系数怎么定？: How is the drop factor determined?
map.由输液器规格决定（常见 15、20 gtt/mL，精密输液器不同），滴速按所用输: It is set by the giving-set specification (commonly 15 or 20 gtt/mL, different for precision sets); the drip rate is calculated with the factor of the set in use, and set according to the label or nursing standards.
map.滴速算出来但要调慢？: The drip rate is calculated but needs slowing down?
map.心肾患者常需更慢；计算值是医嘱时间对应的理论滴速，实际须按患者耐受与医嘱调整，并: Cardiac and renal patients often need a slower rate; the calculated value is the theoretical drip rate matching the prescribed time, and the actual rate must be adjusted to the patient's tolerance and the order, with regular checks.
